(()=>{const r=window.__renderer, gl=r.getContext(), c=window.__composer, s=window.__scene, cam=window.__camera; const T=(f)=>{f(); gl.finish(); const t=performance.now(); for(let i=0;i<5;i++){f(); gl.finish();} return ((performance.now()-t)/5).toFixed(1)}; const sh=r.shadowMap.autoUpdate; const a=T(()=>c.render()); r.shadowMap.autoUpdate=false; const b=T(()=>c.render()); r.shadowMap.autoUpdate=sh; const d=T(()=>r.render(s,cam)); return JSON.stringify({composerMs:a, noShadowUpdateMs:b, directRenderMs:d, size:[innerWidth,innerHeight,r.getPixelRatio()]})})()
